user.title: Set up Family Planner
user.description: Choose the shared family calendar and the family lists. You add people afterwards via “Configure”.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Family Planner is already set up.

data.name: Name
data.person_entity: Person in Home Assistant (for home/away and the phone view)
data.rotation: Takes part in the chore rotation

data.name: Name
data.rotation: Takes part in the chore rotation

kalender.title: Extra calendars
kalender.description: All optional. Create local calendars with the “Local Calendar” integration, waste collection and school holidays with “Remote Calendar” (ICS link).

data.wetter_hinweis: Weather hint before events with a location
data.konflikt_warnung: Warn about event conflicts (double bookings, driver busy)

termin_anlegen.name: Create event
termin_anlegen.description: Creates an event in a person's or the family calendar.

person.name: For whom
person.description: Person key (e.g. anna) or familie for the whole family.

ort.name: Where
ort.description: Location (used for weather and travel time hints).

benachrichtigen.name: Notify
benachrichtigen.description: Send a push notification to the person.

gericht_planen.name: Plan a meal
gericht_planen.description: Adds a meal to the meal plan and puts the ingredients on the shopping list.

zutaten.name: Ingredients
zutaten.description: One per line or comma separated.

benachrichtigen.name: Notify
benachrichtigen.description: Sends a push notification to one person or everyone.

person.name: To
person.description: Person key or familie for everyone.

morgen_ansage.name: Morning briefing
morgen_ansage.description: Plays the daily briefing on the Alexa devices and returns the text.

punkte_buchen.name: Book points
punkte_buchen.description: Adds points for a person (race, account, total and family goal). Admins only.

aufgaben.name: Number of tasks
aufgaben.description: Counts towards daily and weekly stats.

belohnung_einloesen.name: Redeem reward
belohnung_einloesen.description: Deducts the cost from the points account and adds a task to the family list.

person.name: Person
person.description: Leave empty for the signed-in person.

fahrzeug_waehlen.name: Choose vehicle
fahrzeug_waehlen.description: Change vehicle and colour on the race track. Children only for themselves, admins for everyone.

fahrzeug.name: Vehicle
fahrzeug.description: Auto, Rennwagen, Motorrad, Pferd, Einhorn, Fahrrad, Traktor or Rakete.

rennen_neu_starten.name: Start new race
rennen_neu_starten.description: Resets all race points to 0. Account, level and streaks stay.

belohnungen.name: Rewards
belohnungen.description: List with name, kosten and optional icon.

dienste_festlegen.name: Set chores
dienste_festlegen.description: Replaces the household chores of the rotation.

dienste.name: Chores
dienste.description: List with titel, punkte, tage (0 = Monday) and optional versatz.

schatzkarte_festlegen.name: Set treasure map
schatzkarte_festlegen.description: Replaces the stations of the family treasure map. Each station is reached with the points the whole family collects together.

stationen.name: Stations
stationen.description: List with name, belohnung (family reward), punkte (family points needed) and optional emoji.

neue_insel.name: New island
neue_insel.description: Starts a new treasure island: the family walks from the beginning again.

termin_aus_satz.name: Event from a sentence
termin_aus_satz.description: Understands a sentence like “Ben has football on Tuesday at 4, Anna drives” and creates the event.

text.name: Sentence
text.description: What, who, when, and optionally who drives.

wochenrueckblick.name: Weekly review
wochenrueckblick.description: Sends everyone their review of this week and a preview of next week now.

aufgabe_nehmen.name: Take a task
aufgabe_nehmen.description: Puts a ready-made chore from the task catalogue on a person's list (due today). Without a person it goes to the signed-in user.

aufgabe.name: Task
aufgabe.description: Key or title from the catalogue.

person.name: Person
person.description: Slug of the person (only admins may assign to others).

katalog_festlegen.name: Set task catalogue
katalog_festlegen.description: Replaces the list of ready-made chores.

aufgaben.name: Tasks
aufgaben.description: List with titel (emoji first = picture), punkte, bereich (kueche, putzen, waesche, ordnung, draussen, tiere) and optional key.
